mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits reuptake of norepinephrine and serotonin, which can potentiate sympathomimetic effects of levodopa and increase risk of hypertension, arrhythmias, and serotonin syndrome.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and mental status closely; consider dose adjustment of either agent if hypertensive episodes or psychiatric symptoms emerge; carbidopa helps mitigate peripheral sympathomimetic effects but central interactions remain.
